about.en: LABUBU is a community memecoin on Solana themed on Pop Mart's Labubu plush characters, with no affiliation to Pop Mart. It is an SPL token launched through pump.fun with mint JB2wezZLdzWfnaCfHxLg193RS3Rh51ThiXxEDWQDpump and 6 decimals, run by a community takeover (CTO) with no issuer behind it; many unrelated tokens share the LABUBU ticker.
